text:
Nadia: quick follow-up from the postmortem on streaming chat partials/timeouts. goal: assign owners, short milestones, and a minimal verification plan. postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/streaming-197499 (summary pinned)

Ishaan: I can own the server-side safe-flush and repro harness. hypothesis: kv-eviction callback racing with final flush. plan: repro harness -> unit + integration tests -> guarded flush behind feature flag. ETA: repro PR in 4d, guarded flush rollout in 14d.

Priyanka: i'll own observability and synthetic detection. will add partial_flag to responses, emit per-request tags (request_id, route, model, region), and create an hourly lightweight synthetic stream from 4 regions. ETA: metrics in 3d, dashboard + PD in 10d.

Jules: i'll take client reconnect/backoff and handshake clamp. will add capped full-jitter backoff, handshake timeout clamp, and reconnect_reason telemetry. prototype in 5d, opt-in flag for rollout.

Nadia: concrete action items so PM/infra can track:
- REM-401: repro harness for mid-stream KV eviction + unit/integration tests. owner: Ishaan. due: 2026-03-30
- REM-402: guarded safe-flush (per-stream fence) + PR behind feature flag. owner: Ishaan. due: 2026-04-12
- REM-403: add partial_flag + per-request telemetry and dashboard. owner: Priyanka. due: 2026-03-29
- REM-404: synthetic hourly stream from 4 regions + weekly digest to #eng-runtime. owner: Priyanka. due: 2026-03-31
- REM-405: client lib: capped full-jitter backoff + handshake clamp + reconnect_reason telemetry behind flag. owner: Jules. due: 2026-04-03
- REM-406: canary automation + auto-rollback criteria (partial_ratio absolute >0.5% or delta >3x baseline). owner: Nadia & infra. due: 2026-04-14

Ishaan: note on REM-402: implementation will use a per-stream fence token and `defer_flush()` when eviction_pending==true. small tail-latency impact expected; will measure p50/p95/p99 in canary.

Jules: reconnect_reason values will be {"handshake_timeout","network_error","server_close","client_exit"}. i'll also emit reconnect_attempt_count and last_reconnect_ms. will gate behind `client.backoff_v2` flag.

Priyanka: alerting proposal: WARN if partial_ratio >0.15% for 10m -> notify #incidents. PAGE if partial_ratio >0.5% for 5m OR synthetic stream fail >2 runs -> page oncall. please confirm.

Nadia: sounds reasonable. @sre-bot please open ticket for PD rule and link it here.

sre-bot: created ticket SRE-512 for partial-response PD rule and assigned to Nadia. link: https://redwood.internal/sre/SRE-512

ops-bot: created remediation board entry and scheduled weekly check-ins: https://redwood.internal/remediations/1975001234; recurring sync Wed 08:30 PST starting 2026-03-25.

Ishaan: risk/rollback note: guarded flush may add ~10-50ms to final-chunk latency for some streams. rollback path: flip feature-flag off and revert guarded-flush PR. will document exact revert commands in REM-402 ticket.

Jules: i'll add client opt-out so we can quickly disable new backoff behavior for cohorts if needed. also adding a debug endpoint for QA to trigger reconnect sequences.

Priyanka: i'll start the synthetic stream in staging once metrics land and will post weekly correlation reports that link model load events with partial spikes.

Nadia: check-ins: weekly sync Wed 08:30 PST, and immediate status post after each canary day. next check-in: 2026-03-25 08:30 PST. update REM tickets with progress and blockers before meeting.

Ishaan: opening repro PR today and will tag Jules for client interplay review.

Jules: will review and add client-side tests for handshake edgecases.

Priyanka: closing this follow-up thread for now. will reopen if canary shows regressions. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
